topic: Size and growth of food e-commerce
claim_a: About 1% of food retail value in 2024, growing 29% (Euromonitor via USDA, CHN-01)
claim_b: Grocery and food on four marketplaces VND 19.55 trillion in H1 2026, up 151% on H1 2025; about 2.7% of the 2024 food retail base if doubled for the year (ECR-02; our calculation)
position_taken: Both stand: different years and scopes. Use CHN-01 for 2024 and Metric for 2026, with the caveat that Metric does not publish its category definition or method
notes: Metric implies about 1.1% for H1 2025 on the same base, which agrees with CHN-01; the gap is growth in 2026, not a conflict of measurement

topic: Whether protein content now sells plant milk
claim_a: Rising searches for high-protein nut milk and Vinamilk's Sua Hat Cao Dam are the first sign that protein content sells in this aisle (ch23; CON-37; BUY-16)
claim_b: On Kamereo the protein-claimed GoldSoy Giau Dam soy milk sold 2,609 units against 5,758 and 5,828 for unclaimed unsweetened soy milks priced higher (ECR-06)
position_taken: Keep the ch23 statement for consumer search and one product; add that the kitchen channel does not show it
notes: Different buyers (households against kitchens), cumulative counters with unknown start dates, and a stock-out for GoldSoy: weak evidence either way
